item.title: UK to provide Saudi Arabia with defensive military aid
item.description: The United Kingdom will offer military assistance to Saudi Arabia, including air-to-air refuelling for "defensive" operations. This support follows a request from Saudi Arabia. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Official Discusses AI Safety Notifications with China
item.description: U.S. official Scott Bessent met with China's vice premier to propose a system of AI safety notifications between the two countries. The discussions focused on ensuring safety in the development and deployment of artificial intelligence. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Canada Pledges $100 Million in Aid for Palestinians
item.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney announced that Canada will provide $100 million in new aid for Palestinians in Gaza and the West Bank. The aid will largely focus on humanitarian assistance. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.
